last_verified_done: PR #115 merged. Construction/reward presentation for Core Experience v2 is implemented and verified. Rank 1 Rack Wing, Second Packing Bench, and Forklift Project plus Rank 2 Fast Pick Rack, High Density Rack, Parallel Pack Line, and Fast Pack Cell now show physical semi-transparent planned geometry in the selected warehouse Zone before commitment. First preview tap does not spend cash; switching equipment replaces the old ghost; switching Zones or closing the Zone Panel clears stale preview geometry. Successful authoritative build/renovation clears the ghost, real equipment geometry becomes active, and a short selected-Zone construction emphasis bridges into the existing authoritative Before/After measurement. Godot CI #278, iOS Export Smoke #95, Rendered Visual Capture #76, Android Export Smoke #90 all succeeded. rank2_preview.png at 390x844 was human-inspected: the warehouse remains visible behind the STORAGE Zone Panel, the High Density Rack planned ghost is visible before spend, and strength/weakness/¥9,000 renovation information remains readable.
blocked: No Mac-independent implementation blocker for Vertical Slice v2. Native physical-iPhone DEVICE_VALIDATION remains deferred until Mac/Xcode access becomes available, but it is not the current active-phase blocker.
next: Run the next iPhone Web Core Experience playtest on the current engineering preview before adding any more content. Re-test the four original failure modes: (1) play drifting into Management-clicker behavior, (2) equipment/facility change not being perceptible during ordinary play, (3) unclear information hierarchy or action→consequence in the Zone/Management UI, and (4) repetitive decision feel. Also verify preview→ghost→commit→physical change→measurement comprehension with normal touch interaction. Keep ACTIVE_PHASE=VERTICAL_SLICE until this human playtest passes; only then route back to DEVICE_VALIDATION.
greenlight_after_device_validation: Record GO / HOLD / KILL with evidence. PRODUCTION_DECISION remains UNDECIDED until this GREENLIGHT decision.
